 THIS MFA FILED UNDER SECTION 173(1) OF MV ACT PRAYING TO MODIFY THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 27.06.2019 PASSED IN MVC NO. 327/2018 ON THE FILE OF THE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND ADDITIONAL MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS TRIBUNAL, HARIHARA AND ALLOW THE APPEAL BY ENHANCING THE COMPENSATION AS PRAYED.
 THIS MFA, COMING ON FOR HEARING, THIS DAY,
DR.CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA .J., DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:

JUDGMENT Heard Sri Rajath S who represents Sri Praveen Kumar, learned counsel who is on record for the appellant as well as Sri Ashok N Patil, learned counsel appearing for respondent No 3.
2.
This appeal is preferred challenging the order that is rendered by Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, NC: 2024:KHC:21035-DB Harihara in MVC No.327/2018 dated 27.06.2019.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, NC: 2024:KHC:21035-DB Harihara
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The claimant is before this Court seeking enhancement of compensation.

The Tribunal through the impugned order awarded a sum of Rs.3,31,787/- under different heads as detailed under:
 Sl.
Heads Amount  No

1 Loss of future earning capacity Rs.1,55,520  2 Pain and sufferings Rs. 30,000  3 Loss of amenities Rs. 15,000  4 Medical expenses Rs. 97,267  5 Food, nourishment and attendant Rs. 4,500 Smt. Kotramma vs Manjunath.

G on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59173851/
2  charges  6
Towards future medical expenses Rs. 25,000  7 Loss of income during laid up period Rs. 4,500 from 31.12.2017 to 11.01.2018 Total Rs.3,31,787 3.

During the course of arguments, when the learned counsel for the appellant states that the amount awarded as compensation is grossly low, Sri Ashok N Patil, learned counsel representing respondent No 3 submits that the Tribunal has arrived at just conclusion but there NC:
2024:KHC:21035-DB may be marginal enhancement.

At this juncture, on the intervention of the Court, both learned counsel i.e., learned counsel for the appellant as well as learned counsel for the respondent filed joint calculation memo by which it is agreed upon that the enhancement may be to an extent of Rs.1,03,560/-.
4. We are of the view that there is nothing to interfere with the understanding arrived at between both the parties and in respect of the enhancement.
Thus, taking into consideration the memo thus filed, the appeal is accordingly disposed of.
Thus, the following :
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) The amount awarded as compensation through the impugned order in favour of the appellant is enhanced by Rs.1,03,560/-.
NC: 2024:KHC:21035-DB iii) The enhanced amount shall carry interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till the date of deposit.
iv) The 3rd respondent is directed to deposit the enhanced sum within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of this order.
v) On such deposit, the appellant is permitted to withdraw the entire amount.
